description: This file contains unit tests for JSON socket stream communication within the WPEFramework project, including class definitions for command parameters, command objects, a JSON connector template, and a test case that sets up a socket server and client to exchange JSON messages.

classes.name: Parameters
classes.description: Represents command parameters with speed, duration, command type, and settings, used for JSON serialization/deserialization.

classes.name: Command
classes.description: Represents a command with identifier, name, base address, trick flag, and parameters, used for JSON serialization/deserialization.

classes.name: JSONObjectFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating Command JSON objects, manages a pool of Command instances.

classes.name: JSONConnector<INTERFACE>
classes.description: A template class for JSON socket stream communication, handling message sending, receiving, and connection state management.

methods.name: Parameters()
methods.description: Constructor initializing JSON container with speed, duration, command, and settings fields.

methods.name: Command()
methods.description: Constructor initializing JSON container with command properties.

methods.name: Element(const string&)
methods.description: Returns a JSON element proxy for a Command object.

methods.name: Received(Core::ProxyType<Core::JSON::IElement>&)
methods.description: Handles incoming JSON messages, either submitting them or storing for retrieval.

methods.name: Send(Core::ProxyType<Core::JSON::IElement>&)
methods.description: Placeholder for sending JSON messages (not implemented).

methods.name: StateChange()
methods.description: Handles state changes, signals when the connection is open.

methods.name: IsIdle()
methods.description: Indicates whether the connector is idle.
